descripcion: HAMPSTEAD. La hija de la viuda Eley, en la casa de su madre. Aqui se sabe lo del agua.
_regla: Lo cuenta sin darle importancia: nadie subraya el agua.

abre.texto: Miss Eley? I am Henry Whitehead, curate of St Luke's, in Soho. I am sorry for your mother.

ella.texto: Soho? She had not been there for months, Reverend. The air here is clean. I do not understand it.

opciones.texto: What did she eat and drink, those last days?

agua.texto: Nothing new. She liked the water from the Broad Street pump, so the cart brought her a big bottle every day. She drank it on Thursday and on Friday.

prima.texto: My cousin was staying with her. She went home to Islington, and she died there too.

mas.texto: Is there anything else you want to ask, Reverend?

opciones.texto: What did she eat and drink, those last days?

adios.texto: Thank you, Miss Eley. I must go back to Soho.

_regla2: Se puede volver a preguntar; solo se despide tras oír las dos cosas.
